tools.name: how_ringback_works
tools.description: Facts about Ringback, missed-call text-back for contractors and home-service businesses: how the text is sent, phone requirements (Android, iPhone options), what the owner sees, price ($17/month or $170/year per business line), the 7-day free trial with no card, and what Ringback does not do.
